caption: The drawing depicts a single whip, shown horizontally on a plain beige background. The whip has a thick, light brown handle with a diamond-patterned braiding, and a small loop at the left end. The main body of the whip tapers from a wider point near the handle to a narrower end, and is composed of tightly braided material in a greyish tone. Extending from the equipped handle, two leather straps, one brown and one grey, hang down and are partially braided together; their ends split into multiple thinner segments. The background is unadorned, and the entire composition is focused on the detailed rendering of the whip with attention to the textures and natural colors of leather. The drawing is signed and dated “Alexander Anderson – 1940” in faint letters at the lower center.
title: Rawhide Herder's Whip
